title: A Songbook for the Harbor
author: Beatrix Villalobos
blurb: Ivo Quintana, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
